text:
Sam W: Proposal: small console panel 'Fallback Inspector' showing why an automatic fallback happened: rule, trigger, mode, decision_id, trace link, and 'replay (dry-run)'. Lightweight view.

Maya R: Agree. Need stable telemetry keys first.

Oliver K: Dont surface request payloads by default. Show sampled_request_id and trace_id; full payload only with tenant opt-in and auditor RBAC.

Carla L: UI should include a tiny timeline with decision_time_ms and pre->post route. Breadcrumbs for rule order would help.

infra-bot: autofallback-inspector-v1 toggled on in staging for 5% traffic.

Nikhil P: API suggestion: explain(decision_id, level=summary|full) where summary is compact and full contains pointers to trace/audit. Standardize keys: fallback.trigger, fallback.rule_id, fallback.mode, fallback.decision_id, fallback.cost_delta.

OpsOnCall: Ops needs quota details when quota_exceeded triggers, counts of fallbacks in last 5m/1h, and a mute toggle for noisy rules.

Maya R: Add 'Preview fallback (dry-run)' button that simulates behavior without changing routing.

Oliver K: Retention: full envelopes 30d, metadata counters 365d. Default redact request text unless tenant allows. RBAC: only auditors see expanded payloads.

Sam W: I'll open a GH issue listing owners: frontend (Carla), decision-api (Nikhil), telemetry (Oliver), dry-run (Maya), ops controls (OpsOnCall). Prototype ETA ~2 weeks.

OpsOnCall: Safety: limit replay per decision_id to 5/min and global replay to 100/min; log actor and IP.

Sam W: Thanks all. We'll iterate on mocks and the API. :thumbsup:
